Queens, NYC - Swastikas were sprayed across multiple synagogues and Jewish sites yesterday in a neighborhood with a large Jewish population.
Sadly, one of the swastikas was defaced onto a cornerstone dedicated to Kristallnacht survivors, a direct, chilling echo of Nazi violence.
Nearby, the Rego Park Jewish Center was also vandalized with "Heil Hitler" graffiti.

Briahna Joy Gray is an independent political commentator and host of the “Bad Faith” podcast. She has repeatedly drawn backlash for her outspoken commentary on Israel and Gaza, including a widely condemned interview with a Hamas hostage’s sister in which she famously rolled her eyes in annoyance and made statements defending Hamas.
This week, she posted: “Hamas is a thousand times better than the IDF.”
